description: A snapshot taken over the same trees restores: the state is the real refresh of data.kdl, which imports $lib/part.kdl, with lib read from the unchanged lib directory, and the snapshot records lib's identity; its one record line was edited after the refresh to hold locale nb-no where the reading binds sv-se (the payload digest restamped), so a restore prints nb-no and a replay prints sv-se. The record prints nb-no, proving the restore was taken (a hit), and the state is left byte-identical
